name: Seal
summary: A rolling exercise to finish: balanced in a tuck with the hands threaded inside the legs to hold the ankles, clap the feet three times, roll back, clap three times, roll up.
steps: Sit balanced with knees open, arms threaded between the legs and hands holding the outside of the ankles.
Clap the feet together three times.
Breathe in to roll back to the shoulder blades and clap three times.
Breathe out to roll up and balance.

layers.title: Balance and clap
layers.text: Hold the tuck and clap the feet three times.

layers.title: Roll back and up
layers.text: Roll to the shoulder blades and back to balance.

layers.title: Clap at both ends
layers.text: Three claps at the back and three at the front.

cues:
Stay round.
The clap comes from the hips, not the knees.
Stop on the shoulders, never the neck.
